messages:
Ava (CS): VantageClinic week0 update: SOC put onboarding on hold. Two asks: 1) evidence of immutable audit export into their Splunk instance with signed delivery proofs, 2) a key rotation plan that guarantees no gaps for the 2yr retention requirement. they said procurement may delay if we don't close both. tagging @Samira and @Noah.

Noah (Solutions): understoood. i can run an end-to-end replay into their staging HEC and produce a signed manifest of delivered events. need a presigned S3 URL and a staging HEC token.

Samira (Security): i'll draft a key policy template that limits key usage to the forwarder role and their vpce. also proposing a rotation overlap window (48h dual-decrypt) and an immutable delivery ledger signed with our cert. dropping redacted snippet for review:
```json
\{"Version\":\"2012-10-17\",\"Statement\":\[\{\"Sid\":\"ForwarderOnly\",\"Effect\":\"Allow\",\"Principal\":\{\"AWS\":\"arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/vantage-forwarder\"\},\"Action\":\[\"kms:Decrypt\",\"kms:GenerateDataKey\"\],\"Condition\":\{\"StringEquals\":\{\"aws:SourceVpc\":\"vpc-0f1e2d3c4b\"\}\}\}\]\n\}
```

Eric (Ops): ops note: in a prior replay we saw ~0.8% drop when HEC returned 503 under load. mitigation = persistent checkpointing + batch jitter + exponential retries. adding idempotency keys avoids duplicates on replay. runbook excerpt: 
```
# forwarder conf
max_batch: 150
batch_timeout_ms: 1200
retries: 9
checkpoint_interval: 30s
idempotency: true
```

Noah (Solutions): i'll produce a small signed manifest file (sha256 per object + timestamp + signer id) and a Splunk count query that customers can run to validate totals. example verification command i'll include in the playbook.

Ava (CS): action items: 1) @Noah request presigned S3 + staging HEC token from customer by EOD. 2) @Samira post rotation overlap policy + KMS snippet. 3) @Eric run replay and post signed manifest + splunk counts. tagging @Lena because this is a possible renewal risk until SOC signs off.

audit-bot: Reminder: VantageClinic week0 follow-up meeting scheduled 6280014000 (in 2h).

Lena (Renewals): noted. marking as 'watch' in CRM. if SOC still blocks after replay we should escalate to a short exec call. i'll prepare playbook language to reassure procurement.

Samira (Security): also recommending we provide a short threat model blurb explaining replay integrity and certificate pinning for their SOC. i'll attach it to the policy doc.

Eric (Ops): i'll run the replay once presigned URL is up and will paste the pre/post counts + any error lines. will also include the runbook diff that enforces idempotency.

Ava (CS): thanks team  keep thread updated. if we get signoff i'll close the renewal watch and update the account plan.
